rows.name: Colson Yankoff
rows.note: Yankoff (knee) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

rows.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
rows.note: Croskey-Merritt (groin) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

rows.name: Luke McCaffrey
rows.note: McCaffrey returned two punts for 13 yards and three kickoffs for 58 yards in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

rows.name: Laremy Tunsil
rows.note: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said Monday that Tunsil (triceps) is progressing as anticipated and is ready to begin the strength portion of his recovery program, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

rows.name: Jeremy Reaves
rows.note: Reaves recorded nine tackles (seven solo), one pass defense and one fumble recovery during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Nick Cross
rows.note: Cross finished Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants with six tackles (one solo).

rows.name: Frankie Luvu
rows.note: Luvu recorded six tackles (two solo) and a forced fumble during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Sonny Styles
rows.note: Styles recorded 13 tackles (five solo) during the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Drew Stevens
rows.note: Stevens made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on all three of his extra-point tries in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.

rows.name: Ben Sinnott
rows.note: Sinnott caught all four of his targets for 42 yards and a touchdown Thursday in a 24-21 victory against the Giants.

rows.name: Treylon Burks
rows.note: Burks caught two of three targets for 27 yards Thursday in a 24-21 win over the Giants.

rows.name: Antonio Williams
rows.note: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Austin Ekeler
rows.note: Ekeler rushed nine times for 26 yards and brought in all four targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Rachaad White
rows.note: White rushed 11 times for 47 yards and brought in one of two targets for five yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Stefon Diggs
rows.note: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Jayden Daniels
rows.note: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

rows.name: Chig Okonkwo
rows.note: Okonkwo (back) returned to Thursday's eventual 24-21 win at the Giants, finishing with four catches (on eight targets) for 24 yards.
